minimumRecommendedPolicy.reviewBoundary: Do not describe policy pin updates as cryptographic review proof. Required non-author review or a separately trusted review attestation is still needed to protect policy/workflow edits. No generic trust-on-first-use of arbitrary HEAD/base commits.
